snippet.title: Swarm - New 8 Minutes Gameplay Preview | HD
snippet.description:
Watch over 8 minutes of new gameplay footage from the XBLA Game Swarm.
Swarm, a game that lets the player take control of 50 utterly fearless Swarmites and drive them through an intense, entertaining and often suicidal battle for a greater good. You will run, bash, huddle, boost, stack, jump, push and throw your way through gauntlets of death and destruction in an attempt to collect valuable DNA and ensure that at least one Swarmite survives. Swarm is being developed by Hothead Games and will be available early 2011.
